This interactive soundboard provides one-click audio playback for all voice clips and narrations across **Session 4 (*The God's Demand*)** and **Session 5 (*The Wrath of Mars*)**. You can play them directly on any device (phone, tablet, laptop) during table play.

## Session 4: The God's Demand

### Scene 0: The Farbog Crossing

::: {.callout-note}
## 🔊 Scene 0 Opening Read-Aloud

**Voice:** Fable (Narrator) | **Trigger:** When the contubernium emerges from the northern woods onto the causeway bank.

```{=html}
<audio controls preload="none" style="width: 100%; margin: 8px 0;">
  <source src="audio/clips/s4_scene0_marsh_readaloud.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  Your browser does not support the audio element.
</audio>
```

> *"The trees thin out and the ground goes soft underfoot before you see why. Ahead, the hillside opens in a mouth — not a metaphor. A skull carved from the living rock, easily twenty feet across, its eye sockets black even at midday. A causeway of bone and old skulls runs from between its teeth down into a wide, glowing green marsh that splits around the path like water around a stone."*
:::

::: {.callout-caution}
## 🔊 Banshee Dread Mother — Mid-Causeway Ambush

## Session 5: The Wrath of Mars

### Scene 0: Cold Open — The Crystal Is Failing

::: {.callout-note}
## 🔊 Scene 0 Opening Read-Aloud

**Voice:** Fable (Narrator) | **Trigger:** Immediately following the Glabrezu's fall as the crystal focus shudders and cracks.

```{=html}
<audio controls preload="none" style="width: 100%; margin: 8px 0;">
  <source src="audio/clips/s5_scene0_descent_readaloud.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  Your browser does not support the audio element.
</audio>
```

> *"The crystal-star's light does not fade when the demon guarding it falls. It gets worse. Cracks spread across its faces like frost across a window, and each one lets out a note too low to be a sound, felt in the teeth more than heard. In the silence where Tribune Lucius once stood, the stone floor shudders. Whatever this crystal feeds, it just fed it more than it wanted — and the only stairs lead down."*
:::

::: {.callout-caution}

<audio controls preload="none" style="width: 100%; margin: 8px 0;">

> *"Again. Always again. Tell me this time is the one that ends it."*
:::

::: {.callout-caution}
## 🔊 Vercingetorix Bound — Final Death & Winch Revelation

**Voice:** Fable (Dying King) | **Trigger:** When reduced to 0 HP by radiant damage or a Belatucadrus-consecrated blade.

```{=html}
<audio controls preload="none" style="width: 100%; margin: 8px 0;">
  <source src="audio/clips/s5_vercingetorix_final_death.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  Your browser does not support the audio element.
</audio>
```

> *"The granite altar ahead... look to the four massive iron chain winches in the floor. Caesar's siege engineers forged them from captured Gallic steel to bind a god's avatar. Lock the four iron rings... they will drag Mars down and shatter his divine invulnerability. Only then can the spear be broken on the anvil! Tell me... after two hundred years... does Gaul still stand?"*
:::
